text.text: Crowning does not place an ornament upon a tool. It makes the tool bear a station that was not formerly its own. Once fixed, the Crown cannot be removed.

The Crown grants Substrate and Elevation. Substrate is assigned to Reception and Tuning; Elevation serves Sublimation and Investiture. Reception admits further enhancements, while Tuning quiets structural burden and make tool harmony. Sublimation ascends through the tool's own definition; Investiture inherits the intrinsic traits of another.

effects: The Crown is not donned—it is borne
Assign the Crown's gifts at the Transcendence Anvil
